message: each tailor phase must render its own progress step — .scanning → step .scanning, .tailoring → step .tailoring, isComposing → step .composing. Keep each arm wired to its matching step
because: review of 2dd0af5: nothing reaches this switch — no test constructs TailorView, and SnapshotGallery renders TailorProgressView(step:) directly over Step.allCases — so swapping two arms leaves the sheet saying "Laying your CV out…" while it scans, with the whole suite green
